name: The Sun
overview: Scripture reveals that God created the sun as the greater light to govern the day, establishing order in creation by dividing day from night and marking times and seasons. The sun's rising and setting are under God's sovereign command, demonstrating His authority over all creation. Beyond its physical role, the sun symbolizes God's presence and protection, as the Lord Himself is described as a sun and shield who graciously provides for those who walk uprightly. The heavens, including the sun, declare the glory and handiwork of God, pointing us to His majesty and sustaining power.
